name: browser-use
headline: claude usage dashboard: track token cost
short_description: A live dashboard that tracks Claude Code’s token usage by project and session. It estimates costs using API pricing. Benefits operations teams managing AI workloads. Connects to Claude Code’s local files.
author: ocodista

sections.overview:
Claude Usage is a local dashboard that monitors Claude Code's token consumption across projects and sessions. It reads Claude's local session logs, measures input, output, and cache tokens, and estimates equivalent API costs in real time. The tool displays activity patterns by hour and day, calculates cache savings, and updates live as you work. All data remains on your machine—the tool never inspects content, only token volume and timestamps. It's built with TypeScript, React, and Bun, and runs via a simple command-line installation.
Monitor token spending across multiple Claude Code projects
Track peak usage hours and optimize session timing
Estimate API costs for Claude usage patterns
Understand cache efficiency and cost savings
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ocodista/claude-usage`
sections.usage:
```
Create a live dashboard that tracks Claude Code's token usage for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The dashboard should display usage by project and session, estimate costs using the latest API pricing, and connect to local files. Provide a summary of the top 5 projects by token usage and a 7-day trend analysis.
```
